intro.title: Build a notes app with create edit delete and search
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple notes application from scratch using plain JavaScript. You will learn to create, edit, delete, and search through notes, all within a single web page. The core programming concept involves managing application state with an array of objects and manipulating the DOM to reflect changes. You'll use fundamental JavaScript constructs like functions, event listeners, and array methods to implement the app's functionality.
intro.usecase: This notes app pattern appears in countless real-world applications where users need to manage dynamic content collections. You'll find it in project management tools like Trello (creating/editing cards), customer relationship systems (managing contact records), and content management dashboards (handling articles or products). As a developer, you'll implement similar create-edit-delete-search functionality for admin panels, data tables, and user-generated content interfaces. Mastering these core operations prepares you for building interactive features in web applications across industries.
